nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What factors influence the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions when substituting diesel oil with biodiesel?
nodes.answer: The reduction of greenhouse gas emissions depends on the feedstock, the inter-esterification process, the storage period, and ambient conditions.
nodes.paragraph: Abstract The energy use and emissions from direct fossil fuel combustion on-farms to power farm machinery was criticallyreviewed. Approximately, 15% of agricultural production costs on-farm are energy-related. A potential solution to more sustainable energy use is a shift toward biofuels from renewable resources. The reduction of greenhouse gas emissions through the substitution of diesel oil with biodiesel depends on the feedstock, the inter-esteri cation process, the storageperiod, and ambient conditions. In modern tractors, increased fuel use ef ciency (or reduced fuel consumption) has been achieved by power/load matching and the use of variable transmission. Engine management systems that are capable of continuously communicating with the engine and transmission to make appropriate adjustments based on inputs receivedfrom the tractor allow for quick and precise responses to changing conditions. As a result, maximum ef ciency and productivity can be obtained from the tractor operating similarly to the traditional gear-up and throttle-back methods of a pro cient operator. The future for autonomous tractors is promising, though not new. Electric-powered tractors are near tocommercialization or are already commercially available. Hybrid electric driven tractors present some advantages in terms of increased energy use ef ciency and functionalities.
